s0201.literal: The Ministry of Revenue was ordered to verify household registers throughout the empire, issue regulations, and proclaim them to all under heaven.
s0201.idiomatic: An order directed the Ministry of Revenue to verify household registers empire-wide, issue regulations, and proclaim them throughout the realm.

s0202.literal: Famine relief was provided to Yidu and other routes.
s0202.idiomatic: Relief was sent to famine-stricken Yidu and other routes.

s0203.literal: An edict stated: "Officials must not detain prisoners and delay lawsuits, causing appeals to higher authority; violators among officials and commoners alike shall be punished.
s0203.idiomatic: An edict declared: "Officials must not hold prisoners and delay lawsuits so that cases are appealed upward; officials and commoners alike who violate this shall be punished.

s0204.literal: " An investiture decree enfeoffed Nurse Zhao, wet nurse to the Prince of Yan, as Lady of Bin State, and posthumously enfeoffed her husband Gong Delu as Duke of Deyu.
s0204.idiomatic: " Nurse Zhao, wet nurse to the Prince of Yan, was enfeoffed as Lady of Bin State, and her husband Gong Delu was posthumously enfeoffed as Duke of Deyu.

s0205.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on renyin day, Xindu of Goryeo's Fengzhou Pacification Commission reported: "The rebel Pei Zhongsun has detained envoys and stubbornly refuses submission; I ask to advance with Hulinci and Wang Guochang by separate routes to attack."
s0205.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on renyin day Xindu of Goryeo's Fengzhou pacification commission reported: "The rebel Pei Zhongsun has detained envoys and stubbornly refuses to submit; I ask to advance with Hulinci and Wang Guochang by separate routes to attack him."

s0207.literal: In Changli County, Pingluan Route, a commoner woman gave birth at midnight with a glow of light; an edict ordered special nurture and care.
s0207.idiomatic: In Changli County, Pingluan Route, a commoner woman gave birth at midnight amid a glow of light; an edict ordered that the child be specially nurtured.

s0208.literal: Some deemed it improper, but the Emperor said: "How fortunate to have produced a worthy person — let no one harbor jealousy."
s0208.idiomatic: Some thought it improper, but the Emperor said: "How fortunate to have produced a worthy person — let no one harbor jealousy."

s0209.literal: Goryeo was ordered to levy troops for the campaign against Jin Island.
s0209.idiomatic: Goryeo was ordered to levy troops for the campaign against Jin Island.

s0210.literal: On guimao day five hundred thousand taels of silver were allocated for the annual expenses of the Henan Branch Secretariat; troops at Xiangyang and Fancheng were also ordered four dou of grain per man per month from this time forward.
s0210.idiomatic: On guimao day five hundred thousand taels of silver were allocated for the Henan branch secretariat's annual expenses, and Xiangyang and Fancheng troops were ordered four dou of grain per man per month from then on.

s0211.literal: On jiachen day able-bodied men were conscripted in readiness against Song.
s0211.idiomatic: On jiachen day able-bodied men were conscripted in readiness against Song.

s0212.literal: On wuwu day Aju led the wanhu Alahan and others to battle at Tuan Beach against Song generals Fan Wenhu and others, routed them, captured over one hundred men including the commander Zhu Sheng, seized their weapons, and rewarded Aju, Alahan, and the rest with gold and silk in graded amounts.
s0212.idiomatic: On wuwu day Aju led the wanhu Alahan and others to battle at Tuan Beach against Song generals Fan Wenhu and others, routed them, captured more than one hundred men including commander Zhu Sheng, seized their weapons, and rewarded Aju, Alahan, and the rest with graded gifts of gold and silk.

s0213.literal: Because of disasters throughout the routes in Zhiyuan 7, this year's silk tax was remitted in varying degrees.
s0213.idiomatic: Because of disasters throughout the routes in Zhiyuan 7, this year's silk tax was remitted in varying degrees.

s0214.literal: In the fifth month, on yichou day, eastern-route troops were ordered to besiege Xiangyang; Saiyid Ajall and Zheng Ding were commanded to lead forces by land and water toward Jiading; Wang Liangchen and Peng Tianxiang were to advance from Chongqing, Jala Buqa from Luzhou, and Qulijisi from Ruzhou to pin down the enemy.
s0214.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on yichou day, eastern-route troops were ordered to besiege Xiangyang; Saiyid Ajall and Zheng Ding were commanded to lead forces by land and water toward Jiading; Wang Liangchen and Peng Tianxiang were to advance from Chongqing, Jala Buqa from Luzhou, and Qulijisi from Ruzhou to pin the enemy down.

s0215.literal: Branch secretaries Yesudai'er and Zheng Ding were reassigned to conduct Branch Secretariat affairs with the army in the field; Saiyid Ajall was to administer branch secretariat affairs at Xingyuan and relay military grain supplies.
s0215.idiomatic: Branch secretaries Yesudai'er and Zheng Ding were reassigned to conduct branch secretariat affairs with the field army; Saiyid Ajall was to administer branch secretariat affairs at Xingyuan and relay military grain.

s0216.literal: On bingyin day Laoyu State sent tribute.
s0216.idiomatic: On bingyin day Laoyu State sent tribute.

s0217.literal: On jisi day Buddhist rites were performed on Qionghua Island.
s0217.idiomatic: On jisi day Buddhist rites were performed on Qionghua Island.

s0218.literal: On xinwei day Dali's thirty-seven departments were divided into three circuits; as the eight tribal chiefs of Dali had newly submitted, an edict was issued to comfort and instruct them.
s0218.idiomatic: On xinwei day Dali's thirty-seven departments were divided into three circuits; as the eight tribal chiefs of Dali had newly submitted, an edict was issued to comfort and instruct them.

s0219.literal: On renshen day inner and outer ceremonial regalia were manufactured.
s0219.idiomatic: On renshen day inner and outer ceremonial regalia were manufactured.

s0220.literal: On dingchou day famine relief was provided to Wei Prefecture.
s0220.idiomatic: On dingchou day relief was sent to famine-stricken Wei Prefecture.

s0221.literal: On yimao day Shi Tianze was appointed Pacification Commissioner for Military and State Affairs of the First Rank.
s0221.idiomatic: On yimao day Shi Tianze was appointed pacification commissioner for military and state affairs of the first rank.

s0222.literal: The Palace Storehouse Directorate was promoted to Rank 3A.
s0222.idiomatic: The Palace Storehouse Directorate was promoted to rank 3A.

s0223.literal: Xindu and Shi Shu memorialized that the Jin Island rebels had been scattered in defeat and the remnant band had fled into Tamna.
s0223.idiomatic: Xindu and Shi Shu reported that the Jin Island rebels had been scattered in defeat and the remnant band had fled into Tamna.

s0224.literal: On xinsi day the Hexi Branch Secretariat was granted one gold tally and one silver gerfalcon tally.
s0224.idiomatic: On xinsi day the Hexi branch secretariat was granted one gold tally and one silver gerfalcon tally.

s0225.literal: Mongol officials' sons who showed aptitude for study were ordered also to learn arithmetic.
s0225.idiomatic: Mongol officials' sons who showed aptitude for study were ordered also to learn arithmetic.

s0226.literal: On guimei day Jizhou was elevated to Jining Prefecture.
s0226.idiomatic: On guimei day Jizhou was elevated to Jining Prefecture.

s0227.literal: The Jade Hall Directorate was placed under the Palace Service Directorate.
s0227.idiomatic: The Jade Hall directorate was placed under the Palace Service directorate.

s0228.literal: King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo sent envoys bearing tribute goods.
s0228.idiomatic: King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

s0229.literal: In the sixth month, on jiawu day, the Privy Council was ordered: "All military matters may be reported directly to the throne without going through the Ministry of Revenue; cases touching funds and grain are to be discussed with that ministry."
s0229.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiawu day the Privy Council was ordered: "All military matters may be reported directly to the throne without going through the Ministry of Revenue; cases touching funds and grain are to be discussed with that ministry."

s0230.literal: Locusts afflicted Shangdu, Zhongdu, Hejian, Jinan, Zilai, Zhending, Weihui, Mingci, Shunde, Daming, Henan, Nanjing, Zhangde, Yidu, Shuntian, Huaimeng, Pingyang, Guide, and other prefectures and counties.
s0230.idiomatic: Locusts afflicted Shangdu, Zhongdu, Hejian, Jinan, Zilai, Zhending, Weihui, Mingci, Shunde, Daming, Henan, Nanjing, Zhangde, Yidu, Shuntian, Huaimeng, Pingyang, Guide, and other prefectures and counties.

s0231.literal: On guimao day Song general Fan Wenhu led Su Liuyi, Xia Song, and others with a fleet of one hundred thousand to relieve Xiangyang; Aju led the generals to intercept, seized over one hundred warships, and the enemy fled in defeat.
s0231.idiomatic: On guimao day Song general Fan Wenhu led Su Liuyi, Xia Song, and others with a fleet of one hundred thousand to relieve Xiangyang; Aju led the generals to intercept, seized more than one hundred warships, and the enemy fled in defeat.

s0232.literal: Pacification Commissioner Heda also sent the wanhu Xie Ruji and others to ambush them, captured the commanders Zhu Rixin and Zheng Gao, and inflicted a major defeat.
s0232.idiomatic: Pacification Commissioner Heda also sent the wanhu Xie Ruji and others to ambush them, captured commanders Zhu Rixin and Zheng Gao, and inflicted a major defeat.

s0233.literal: On xinhai day an edict ordered: "All revenue and grain accounts under civilian administrators shall await year-end assessment for comparison."
s0233.idiomatic: On xinhai day an edict ordered: "All revenue and grain accounts under civilian administrators shall await year-end assessment for comparison."

s0234.literal: On yimao day residents were summoned to settle in Hexi, Waduan, Angiha, and other regions.
s0234.idiomatic: On yimao day residents were summoned to settle in Hexi, Waduan, Angiha, and other regions.

s0235.literal: On jiwei day Tachu and Dong Wenbing of the Shandong Army Command learned that Song intended to hold Whekou River mouth and requested to build fortifications; they then missed the opportunity, and Song troops had already built palisades there.
s0235.idiomatic: On jiwei day Tachu and Dong Wenbing of the Shandong army command learned that Song intended to hold Whekou and requested to build fortifications; they then missed the opportunity, and Song troops had already built palisades there.

s0236.literal: When the matter was reported, an edict ordered differentiated corporal punishment for Tachu, Wenbing, and others.
s0236.idiomatic: When the matter was reported, an edict ordered differentiated corporal punishment for Tachu, Wenbing, and others.

s0237.literal: Locust nymphs appeared in Heshun County, Liaozhou, and Wenxi County, Jiezhou.
s0237.idiomatic: Locust nymphs appeared in Heshun County, Liaozhou, and Wenxi County, Jiezhou.

s0238.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the first day (renxu), the Ministry of Revenue requested that Taiyuan's salt levy be increased with an annual quota of one thousand ingots of paper money, and that the local route administer it concurrently; the request was granted.
s0238.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on the first day (renxu), the Ministry of Revenue requested that Taiyuan's salt levy be increased to an annual quota of one thousand ingots of paper money and that the local route administer it concurrently; the request was granted.

s0239.literal: Staff were appointed to the Muslim Directorate of Astronomy, with Jamaluddin as superintendent.
s0239.idiomatic: Staff were appointed to the Muslim directorate of astronomy, with Jamaluddin as superintendent.

s0240.literal: Jurchen and Suiban troops were conscripted.
s0240.idiomatic: Jurchen and Suiban troops were conscripted.

s0241.literal: Zheng Yuan was put in charge of sacrifices at the mountains and rivers and granted the title Director of Rites for the Altar.
s0241.idiomatic: Zheng Yuan was put in charge of sacrifices at the mountains and rivers and granted the title director of rites for the altar.

s0242.literal: On dingmao day the southerner Li Zhong memorialized that Vice Minister Zhang Dayue of Yunshan had once communicated with Song; finding the allegation unsubstantiated, an edict reassured Dayue: "Song is skilled at subversion — I do not lightly believe it; harbor no doubt or fear."
s0242.idiomatic: On dingmao day the southerner Li Zhong memorialized that Vice Minister Zhang Dayue of Yunshan had once communicated with Song; finding the allegation unsubstantiated, an edict reassured Dayue: "Song is skilled at subversion — I do not lightly believe it; harbor no doubt or fear."

s0243.literal: Prince Touliangge was assigned to conduct Branch Secretariat affairs in Beijing, Liaodong, and other routes.
s0243.idiomatic: Prince Touliangge was assigned to conduct branch secretariat affairs in Beijing, Liaodong, and other routes.

s0244.literal: On xinwei day left, right, and central directorates for the guard armies were established.
s0244.idiomatic: On xinwei day left, right, and central directorates for the guard armies were established.

s0245.literal: On yihai day frost destroyed the grain in Gongchang, Lintao, Pingliang Prefecture, Hui, Lan, and other prefectures.
s0245.idiomatic: On yihai day frost destroyed the grain in Gongchang, Lintao, Pingliang Prefecture, Hui, Lan, and other prefectures.

s0246.literal: On yiyou day Song general Lai Xingguo attacked the Baizhangshan camp; Aju routed him, pursued to Tuan Beach, and took over two thousand heads.
s0246.idiomatic: On yiyou day Song general Lai Xingguo attacked the Baizhangshan camp; Aju routed him, pursued to Tuan Beach, and took more than two thousand heads.

s0247.literal: The Goryeo crown prince Wang Chŏm came as a hostage, and coerced households from Jin Island came to surrender.
s0247.idiomatic: Goryeo crown prince Wang Chŏm came as a hostage, and coerced households from Jin Island came to surrender.

s0248.literal: In the eighth month, on the first day (renchen), there was a solar eclipse.
s0248.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the first day (renchen), there was a solar eclipse.

s0249.literal: On guisi day an edict ordered: "Relay-station households holding four qing or more of land shall pay rent according to regulation."
s0249.idiomatic: On guisi day an edict ordered: "Relay-station households holding four qing or more of land shall pay rent according to regulation."

s0250.literal: On jihai day an edict was issued to summon and instruct Song's Xiangyang defender Lü Wenhuan.
s0250.idiomatic: On jihai day an edict was issued to summon and instruct Song's Xiangyang defender Lü Wenhuan.

s0251.literal: On renzi day the imperial carriage returned from Shangdu.
s0251.idiomatic: On renzi day the Emperor returned from Shangdu.

s0252.literal: The Chengdu Army Command was moved to Meizhou.
s0252.idiomatic: The Chengdu army command was moved to Meizhou.

s0253.literal: On jiwei day, on the Emperor's birthday, inner and outer guard formations and positions for the Cloud-and-Harmony Office musicians were established for the first time.
s0253.idiomatic: On jiwei day, the Emperor's birthday, inner and outer guard formations and positions for the Cloud-and-Harmony Office musicians were established for the first time.

s0254.literal: The Dongchuan Army Command led troops against Song's Tongbo Fort; the fort commander Li Qing and others surrendered; Qing was made military administrator of Liangshan.
s0254.idiomatic: The Dongchuan army command led troops against Song's Tongbo Fort; fort commander Li Qing and others surrendered, and Qing was made military administrator of Liangshan.

s0255.literal: In the ninth month, on the first day (renxu), Grand Marshal Aju was ordered to raid Han lands south of the Han River with his troops.
s0255.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the first day (renxu), Grand Marshal Aju was ordered to raid Han lands south of the Han River with his troops.

s0256.literal: On guihai day Goryeo crown prince Wang Chŏm took leave to return home; King Wang Chŏn was granted western brocades and comforted by a gracious edict.
s0256.idiomatic: On guihai day Goryeo crown prince Wang Chŏm took leave to return home; King Wang Chŏn was granted western brocades and comforted by a gracious edict.

s0257.literal: On jiazi day Liu Zheng was granted five hundred ingots of paper money and five hundred qing of land in Zheng Prefecture; Zheng declined, and he was instead given three hundred civilian households' fields, with the usual levies unchanged.
s0257.idiomatic: On jiazi day Liu Zheng was granted five hundred ingots of paper money and five hundred qing of land in Zheng Prefecture; Zheng declined, and he was instead given three hundred civilian households' fields, with the usual levies unchanged.

s0258.literal: Twenty-eight thousand six hundred ingots of paper money were allocated for the Henan Branch Secretariat's annual expenses.
s0258.idiomatic: Twenty-eight thousand six hundred ingots of paper money were allocated for the Henan branch secretariat's annual expenses.

s0259.literal: On bingyin day the Shaanxi Five-Routes and Xichuan Sichuan Branch Secretariats were abolished; Yesudai'er was assigned to conduct Sichuan Branch Secretariat affairs at Xingyuan; Jingzhao and other routes were placed directly under the central secretariat.
s0259.idiomatic: On bingyin day the Shaanxi Five-Routes and Xichuan Sichuan branch secretariats were abolished; Yesudai'er was assigned to conduct Sichuan branch secretariat affairs at Xingyuan; Jingzhao and other routes were placed directly under the central secretariat.

s0260.literal: Song forces were defeated at the Wo River.
s0260.idiomatic: Song forces were defeated at the Wo River.

s0261.literal: On wuchen day Deyang County in Chengdu Prefecture was elevated to De Prefecture, and Guo Prefecture was downgraded to Guolue County.
s0261.idiomatic: On wuchen day Deyang County in Chengdu Prefecture was elevated to De Prefecture, and Guo Prefecture was downgraded to Guolue County.

s0262.literal: On renshen day ten noble youths including Tuotuomu'er were selected to study at the National University.
s0262.idiomatic: On renshen day ten noble youths including Tuotuomu'er were selected to study at the National University.

s0263.literal: On guiyou day Jizhou in Yidu Prefecture presented two specimens of auspicious fungus.
s0263.idiomatic: On guiyou day Jizhou in Yidu Prefecture presented two specimens of auspicious fungus.

s0264.literal: On jiaxu day Xixia Muslim troops were conscripted.
s0264.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Xixia Muslim troops were conscripted.

s0265.literal: Columns in the Imperial Ancestral Temple hall rotted and collapsed; the censor impeached Liu Jing of the Waterworks for negligent supervision; Jing died from grief.
s0265.idiomatic: Columns in the Imperial Ancestral Temple hall rotted and collapsed; the censor impeached Liu Jing of the Waterworks for negligent supervision, and Jing died from grief.

s0266.literal: Zhang Yi requested advance notice at the temple before completing repairs; the request was granted.
s0266.idiomatic: Zhang Yi requested advance notice at the temple before completing repairs; the request was granted.

s0267.literal: On bingzi day an edict ordered that no sacrificial oxen be used at this year's offerings in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0267.idiomatic: On bingzi day an edict ordered that no sacrificial oxen be used at this year's offerings in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0268.literal: The moon transited the Bi constellation.
s0268.idiomatic: The moon transited the Bi constellation.

s0269.literal: On gengchen day Hududu and others of the Right Guard Army Command reported: "The Whekou fortifications are built, but barracks remain unfinished; all timber and tiles must come from Song territory; we request to lead elite troops on separate raids."
s0269.idiomatic: On gengchen day Hududu and others of the Right Guard army command reported: "The Whekou fortifications are built, but barracks remain unfinished; all timber and tiles must come from Song territory; we request to lead elite troops on separate raids."

s0271.literal: On renwu day the Shandong Route Army Command reported that Song troops attacked Jiaozhou; the qianhu Jiang De and others fought them off and defeated them, capturing over fifty men including the commander Fan Guang and seizing one hundred warships.
s0271.idiomatic: On renwu day the Shandong route army command reported that Song troops attacked Jiaozhou; the qianhu Jiang De and others fought them off and defeated them, capturing more than fifty men including commander Fan Guang and seizing one hundred warships.

s0272.literal: On guimei day an edict exempted the tax on more than five thousand shi of grain lost from Mang'an granary and forbade princes from making unreasonable demands.
s0272.idiomatic: On guimei day an edict exempted the tax on more than five thousand shi of grain lost from Mang'an granary and forbade princes from making unreasonable demands.

s0273.literal: An edict declared that because the people of Sichuan were exhausted, tea and salt levies and other taxes were remitted, and military and civilian field rents would supply frontier troops' rations.
s0273.idiomatic: An edict declared that because the people of Sichuan were exhausted, tea and salt levies and other taxes were remitted, and military and civilian field rents would supply frontier troops' rations.

s0274.literal: Further ordered: "From now on, officials who speak of profiting from tea and salt shall be charged with violation of imperial orders."
s0274.idiomatic: Further ordered: "From now on, officials who speak of profiting from tea and salt shall be charged with violation of imperial orders."

s0275.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on guisi day, the Minister of Agriculture reported: "Huduna, darughachi of Gaotang, prefect Zhang Tingrui, and vice-prefect Chen Siji were effective in promoting agriculture; Wang Zai, county magistrate of Shaan in Henan Prefecture, was remiss in promoting agriculture — promotions and demotions should be applied as encouragement and warning."
s0275.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on guisi day the Minister of Agriculture reported: "Huduna, darughachi of Gaotang, prefect Zhang Tingrui, and vice-prefect Chen Siji were effective in promoting agriculture; Wang Zai, county magistrate of Shaan in Henan Prefecture, was remiss in promoting agriculture — promotions and demotions should be applied as encouragement and warning."

s0277.literal: On dingyou day sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0277.idiomatic: On dingyou day sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0278.literal: On jiwei day storms and flooding destroyed the crops in Tan, Shun, and other prefectures.
s0278.idiomatic: On jiwei day storms and flooding destroyed the crops in Tan, Shun, and other prefectures.

s0279.literal: Goryeo was granted the Zhiyuan 9 calendar.
s0279.idiomatic: Goryeo was granted the Zhiyuan 9 calendar.

s0280.literal: In the eleventh month, on the first day (xinyou), ranked officials' descendants were ordered to serve guard duty; Aru Te'er and others were dispatched to pacify Dali.
s0280.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the first day (xinyou), ranked officials' descendants were ordered to serve guard duty, and Aru Te'er and others were dispatched to pacify Dali.

s0281.literal: On renxu day the directorate-generals for paper currency in all routes were abolished.
s0281.idiomatic: On renxu day the directorate-generals for paper currency in all routes were abolished.

s0282.literal: On yihai day Liu Bingzhong, Wang Pan, Tushan Gonglu, and others submitted: "At New Year's Day, court assemblies, imperial birthdays, amnesties, and all hundred-official proclamations, officials should don formal robes to greet and perform obeisance."
s0282.idiomatic: On yihai day Liu Bingzhong, Wang Pan, Tushan Gonglu, and others submitted: "At New Year's Day, court assemblies, imperial birthdays, amnesties, and all hundred-official proclamations, officials should don formal robes to greet and perform obeisance."

s0284.literal: Use of the Jin dynasty's Taihe Code was prohibited.
s0284.idiomatic: Use of the Jin dynasty's Taihe Code was prohibited.

s0285.literal: The dynastic name Great Yuan was established; the edict read:
s0285.idiomatic: The dynastic name Great Yuan was established; the edict read:

s0286.literal: Having received the glorious mandate, I embrace all within the four seas to dwell in supremacy;
s0286.idiomatic: Having received the glorious mandate, I embrace all within the four seas and dwell in supremacy;

s0287.literal: A worthy name is necessary to continue the hundred kings and record the succession.
s0287.idiomatic: A worthy name is necessary to continue the hundred kings and record the succession.

s0288.literal: This began from high antiquity and is not unique to my house alone.
s0288.idiomatic: This began from high antiquity and is not unique to my house alone.

s0289.literal: Moreover, tang means "expansive," and Yao won renown thereby;
s0289.idiomatic: Moreover, tang means "expansive," and Yao won renown thereby;

s0290.literal: yu means "rejoicing," and Shun took it as his style.
s0290.idiomatic: yu means "rejoicing," and Shun took it as his style.

s0291.literal: Down to Yu's rise and Tang's founding, they alternately named themselves Xia the Great and Yin the Central.
s0291.idiomatic: Down to Yu's rise and Tang's founding, they alternately named themselves Xia the Great and Yin the Central.

s0292.literal: As generations declined, the practice differed from antiquity.
s0292.idiomatic: As generations declined, the practice differed from antiquity.

s0293.literal: Though they seized the moment to hold the realm, they did not craft their titles from profit.
s0293.idiomatic: Though they seized the moment to hold the realm, they did not craft their titles from profit.

s0294.literal: Those called Qin and Han took names from the lands where they first rose;
s0294.idiomatic: Those called Qin and Han took names from the lands where they first rose;

s0295.literal: Those called Sui and Tang drew from the fiefs they had been enfeoffed with.
s0295.idiomatic: Those called Sui and Tang drew from the fiefs they had been enfeoffed with.

s0296.literal: All of these catered to the people's familiar habits and served as stopgap measures for a time — weighed against perfect impartiality, they fall somewhat short.
s0296.idiomatic: All of these catered to the people's familiar habits and served as stopgap measures for a time — weighed against perfect impartiality, they fall somewhat short.

s0297.literal: Our Taizu, the sage and martial emperor, grasped the mandate of Heaven and rose in the northern lands, took the imperial design through divine martial prowess, shook the four quarters with Heaven's thunder, and greatly expanded the realm — the breadth of the map is without precedent in history.
s0297.idiomatic: Our Taizu, the sage and martial emperor, grasped the mandate of Heaven and rose in the northern lands, took the imperial design through divine martial prowess, shook the four quarters with Heaven's thunder, and greatly expanded the realm — the breadth of the map is without precedent in history.

s0298.literal: Recently venerable elders came to court and submitted memorials asking that, the great enterprise already accomplished, the august name should be fixed early.
s0298.idiomatic: Recently venerable elders came to court and submitted memorials asking that, the great enterprise already accomplished, the august name should be fixed early.

s0299.literal: By ancient custom this is only fitting; in my own heart what objection could there be?
s0299.idiomatic: By ancient custom this is only fitting; in my own heart what objection could there be?

s0300.literal: Let the dynastic name be established as Great Yuan, taking the meaning of "Qian yuan" from the Book of Changes.
s0300.idiomatic: Let the dynastic name be established as Great Yuan, taking the meaning of "Qian yuan" from the Book of Changes.
